payload.description_html:
Jaws of Omeisaurus tianfuensis.

Symtemtic position: Manenchisauridae, Sauropodomorpha, Saurischia. Locality: Dashanpu, Zigong, Sichuan, China. Age: Middle Jurassic (about 160 million years ago).

As a large sauropod dinosaur, Omeisaurus tianfuensis is one of the main menmbers of Dashanpu Dinosaur Fauna a lot of postcranials but rare skull. This is a relatively complete skull of Omeisaurus tianfuensis so far known.
